final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoice_count) AS average_invoice_count, AVG(g.invoice_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess_overall_average FROM gender_counts g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.invoice_count > o.avg_count
